example_sentences_in_bangla: সে খই ভাজার মতো অকিঞ্চিৎকর কাজে সময় নষ্ট করছে।
এই প্রকল্পটা খই ভাজা জিনিস, কোনো গুরুত্ব নেই।
example_sentences_in_english: He's wasting time on work as trivial as frying khoi.
This project is like frying khoi—utterly insignificant.
history: The idiom draws from the simple, menial task of frying puffed rice (khoi), a common rural activity in Bengal often done in groups, symbolizing pointless or low-value labor.
note: Frequently extended to 'খই ভাজার দল' to refer to a group engaged in such trivial activities.
